hero_sentence: I build websites and web apps with Python, HTML and CSS, and I test everything I ship.
about_short: I am a software engineering graduate of Southern Delta University. I build websites and web applications with Python, HTML, and CSS, and I test everything I ship.
resume_summary: I am a Software Engineering graduate of Southern Delta University. I enjoy building websites and web applications and have worked on projects using Python, HTML and CSS. My project work includes a personal finance application, business website templates, a fashion website, a music player and a CI/CD pipeline showcase. I have also gained experience working with a professional engineering team and currently work alongside the Data and AI Supervisor and the Software Engineering Department at Delta State Innovation Hub on the SCORE 360 project. I am continuing to develop my skills and am currently learning Java.
about_story: I am Eseoghene Gift-Asisisi Asisisi (GitHub: giftstack-dev), a software engineering graduate of Southern Delta University.

Across five public repositories, I have built personal finance software with Python, pure HTML and CSS business templates, a custom fashion atelier site, a music player web app, and an automated GitHub Actions pipeline.
I continue to expand my work with Python, HTML, and CSS while learning Java on my own.
I use AI tools as a secondary aid for routine work. I write, review and test the code myself.

projects.title: Budget Buddy
projects.one_line_summary: A personal money planner for salary earners in Nigeria.
projects.problem: Salary earners need a structured way to plan monthly and yearly income around essential needs first, track daily spending, and avoid floating-point rounding errors in currency math.
projects.what_i_built: A Python web application with registration, a needs-first monthly and yearly plan, a daily spending log, weekly and monthly feedback, and a demo account. Money is handled as whole kobo (integers) and the code has an automated test suite.
projects.what_i_learned: Handling money as whole kobo integers eliminates rounding drift, and backing features with an automated test suite makes every change safe to ship.
